name: cloudbase
description: Use this skill when you develop, design, build, deploy, debug, migrate, or troubleshoot CloudBase (腾讯云开发, 云开发, TCB, 微信云开发) projects — Web, 微信小程序, 小程序, uni-app, mobile (iOS, Android, Flutter, React Nat

en.tagline: Build, deploy and debug CloudBase (Tencent Cloud) apps
en.summary: CloudBase is a set of backend services for WeChat Mini Programs and Web/H5 apps, including databases, cloud functions, cloud storage, auth and hosting. This skill guides an AI agent through building, deploying, debugging and migrating CloudBase projects. It sends each task to the matching reference so the agent works from the right rules.
problem: CloudBase has two separate account systems, one for the domestic site and one for the international site. A login on the wrong site often shows no environments and no clear error. Other common failures come from using the wrong database type, skipping auth provider setup, or writing frontend code before backend resources exist.

With this skill, the agent confirms the site first and reads the matching reference before it writes code. It prepares backend resources through MCP or the tcb CLI, then writes the frontend. Before it reports the work as done, it runs a code review and fixes the errors it finds.
fit: Building a Web, WeChat Mini Program, uni-app or mobile app on CloudBase
Setting up auth, NoSQL or MySQL databases, cloud functions or CloudRun
Debugging or checking a CloudBase environment or its logs
unfit: Projects that do not use CloudBase
Self-hosted backends with no CloudBase services
steps: The agent first confirms whether the project uses the domestic or the international CloudBase site.
It identifies the scenario and reads the matching reference file before writing any code.
It prepares backend resources such as auth providers, tables, storage and security rules, using MCP or the tcb CLI if MCP is not available in the session.
It writes the frontend code, installs dependencies, starts the server and tests the result.
It runs the cloudbase-code-review check, fixes errors and then reports the work as done.

zh.tagline: 为腾讯云开发项目提供开发、部署与排错指引
zh.summary: 云开发为微信小程序和 Web/H5 应用提供后端服务，包括数据库、云函数、云存储、身份认证和静态托管。这个技能指导 AI 助手完成云开发项目的开发、部署、排错和迁移。它会把每个任务指向对应的参考文档，让助手按正确的规则工作。
problem: 云开发有国内站和国际站两套独立的账号体系。登录到错误的站点时，常见现象是看不到任何环境，而且没有明确的报错。其他常见问题包括选错数据库类型、跳过认证服务商的配置，或者后端资源还没准备好就先写前端代码。
使用这个技能后，助手会先确认站点，再阅读对应场景的参考文档，然后才写代码。它通过 MCP 或 tcb CLI 准备后端资源，再编写前端。在报告任务完成之前，它会运行代码检查并修复发现的错误。
fit: 在云开发上开发 Web、微信小程序、uni-app 或移动端应用
配置认证、NoSQL 或 MySQL 数据库、云函数或云托管
排查或检查云开发环境及其日志
unfit: 没有云开发服务的自建后端
steps: 助手首先确认项目使用的是国内站还是国际站。
助手识别任务场景，并在编写任何代码前阅读对应的参考文档。
助手准备后端资源，例如认证服务商、数据表、存储和安全规则；如果当前会话中没有 MCP，则改用 tcb CLI。
助手编写前端代码，安装依赖，启动服务并测试结果。
助手运行 cloudbase-code-review 检查，修复错误，然后报告任务已完成。
